label: Full DOB and postal; email and phone
rationale: As collected today. The baseline every other variant is compared with.

label: Birth year and month; full postal; email and phone
rationale: Drops the day of birth. The matcher sees the first of the month as the date.

label: Birth year; ZIP3 or FSA; email and phone
rationale: The shape the Phase 5 data standard proposes. A day-level DOB can no longer be compared across a person's records.

label: Birth year; ZIP3 or FSA; email only
rationale: Also drops the guardian phone number (a second contact route and a second direct identifier).

label: Birth year; ZIP3 or FSA; hashed email (match only)
rationale: The email is kept only as a hash, so records can be matched but a guardian cannot be reached. ACTIVATE fitness is zero by construction. ASSUMPTION: a real design would use a keyed hash held outside the analytics platform.
